yamlMapping.truthyLookupCaveat: The source uses || in getSetting and in prefixed/unprefixed/capitalized lookup. Falsy values can fall through. This is a literal lookup contract, not proof that every downstream converter consumes every camelized overlay key.
yamlMapping.nativeOptionInjection: Native macOS construction/injection of export options remains outside the inspected JS evidence.

pandocCli.jsNodeArgv: E_pandocArgvX: always starts -f native -s -o <path> -t <fmt> with wiki->mediawiki, latex-pdf->pdf. extraArguments concatenated. Flags via w(): --reference-doc, --template, --css, --split-level, --toc-depth, --toc, --pdf-engine. Markdown-specific flags when type markdown.
pandocCli.macNativeBackend: File.isMac exportToNative / bridge export.exportToNative. Final argv and defaults unknown. Do not infer from generic Pandoc docs.
pandocCli.argUI: disabled computed string; not independently persisted as source of truth vs structured fields
pandocCli.computedArgPersistence: Structured field onChange handlers compute arg via t("arg", ...); Preferences te() persists that key inside export.<group>. The inspected Node x() builds argv from structured values, not from arg. How macOS native uses arg remains unknown.

unknowns: Native macOS PDF/WebKit print defaults (page size, margins, header/footer engine) vs JS paper control fallbacks.
How native injects export.<group> into ClientCommand.export payload / File.option flattening.
Whether customExport first-run equals X in native defaults store.
Pandoc auto-detect search paths on macOS; bundled vs PATH.
Final native Pandoc argv (WK/ObjC) vs Node x() builder.
Whether allowPerFileSetting schema checkbox has a stored true default (no schema default on j/L; checkbox renderer treats missing as false).
Cover image / epub-cover: not found as schema field.
split-level / title / outline YAML keys exist in whitelist but PDF Typora/Webkit schema has no split-level control (epub has toc-depth). Native consumption of YAML split-level for PDF unknown.
Whether export.general.openExportLocation is written true by native first launch (General UI treats missing as false).
GUI never observed; coordinator GUI audit independent.
